capabilities: browse albums in grid, list and artist views
track spins, ratings and annual listening goals
turn Markdown lists into progress boards
search album metadata and covers online
disambiguation: Not a slideshow or presentation tool; it builds a music library and listening log out of Markdown notes.
extras: Online lookups are user-initiated and can be turned off for fully offline use; no API key needed. Manual installation from GitHub releases only.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to browse a large album collection visually or to log listens and ratings against notes.
